rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Believe This with Me
card.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The house is migrating south. Help me redirect it before we lose the driveway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The surveyor says subsidence. He's bringing concrete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Concrete traps it halfway across the road. Tell him we're planning a route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His truck's blocking the road already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Ask him to lead slowly toward the empty plot. It needs a guide.

card.title: Believe This with Me
card.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The office kettle's on strike. Help me negotiate before the clients arrive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've filled it twice. It still won't boil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then water isn't its grievance. Tell it we'll stop leaving it alone after meetings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can take it into the meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Give it my chair. A seat at the table should get us tea.

card.title: Test the Impossible Claim
card.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This tap runs tomorrow's water. Fill that ice tray; we'll see whether it freezes before we chill it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why can't you fill it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm timing. Your finger's already on the tap.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll fill one cube. We need the rest for dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One's enough. Leave it on the counter so the freezer can't take credit.

card.title: Test the Impossible Claim
card.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's an invisible bridge across this ditch. Tap for it with your umbrella before I cross.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Use your walking stick.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yours extends. You can test it without leaving the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll extend it, but you're holding my belt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. Reach until it touches something, then tell me whether it's above the water.

card.title: Credit for the Impossible
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I drew that floating staircase last week. Mention the date.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can all see it now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I drew the handrail while you called it nonsense.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Well done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Loud enough for the people using my prediction to get upstairs.

card.title: Credit for the Impossible
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believed this cupboard could speak when you wanted it scrapped. Say I was first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's asking for silence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whisper it. Then we can both respect its wishes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says whispering counts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write it, then. 'You believed before any of us.' I'll put it beside its first words.

card.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
card.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we move the sofa: are we shrinking while the room stays normal, or is the room growing while we stay normal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever gets this move finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shrinking means call full-sized help. Growing means hurry before the door gets farther away. Choose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him to bring tweezers. He'll need to collect us afterward.

card.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
card.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The sandwiches are floating. Is gravity late for lunch, or has it resigned? We need a serving plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The guests arrive in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Late means plates underneath. Resigned means string on every sandwich. Which are we doing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Late. We haven't enough string.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then fetch the deep plates. We may get the whole buffet at once.

card.title: Act as If It’s True
card.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The ceiling's hungry. Turn the breakfast tray upside down so it can eat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's our last porridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep half for us. Just turn its bowl over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll use the tray to catch anything it drops.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Hold it under the light fitting; that's where it dribbled yesterday.

card.title: Act as If It’s True
card.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your sister's arriving backward through time. Put her chair away so it'll be here when she leaves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm setting places for dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Her departure is our arrival. Fold hers first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll label it so nobody unfolds it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write 'occupied.' That's how we keep it available for her.

card.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop resetting the light. Ask the house whether it wants darkness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's an electrical fault.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the house can say so.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: House, would you like the light on?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Wait for an answer before reaching for the fuse.

card.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop lifting the sofa. The keys have made themselves invisible because you're angry with them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're jingling under this cushion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they've heard you. Put the cushion down and apologize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologize, but I'm checking underneath first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No checking. Tell them we trust them to come out when they're ready.

card.title: I Started the Weirdness
card.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The cups are floating. I'll tie them down while you rescue breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You flicked that gravity switch reaching for the toaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could've been the toaster. Give me the string; I'll secure everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole table's rising. Hold my ankles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got you. I'll anchor us to the radiator. Let's list what floated, not who touched what.

card.title: I Started the Weirdness
card.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll feed the little demon. You get our curtains out of its mouth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It appeared when you read that novelty mug aloud.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Those mugs say all sorts. I'll fetch crackers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only eats words. It's chewing the lease.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll swap in the mug and save our deposit. No need to preserve every possible clue.

card.title: Don’t Question the Premise
card.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The ghost's waiting at our breakfast table. Do we have cereal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it haunting our kitchen? We're already late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give it the instant porridge. I'll find a bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would a dead person need feeding? I'm taking the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it in a travel cup. You can drop it at the cemetery on your way.

card.title: Don’t Question the Premise
card.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hold this bucket under the seascape. I'll get towels before the gallery floor floods.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is a painting leaking? I said we should buy a print.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can choose the replacement. Tilt the bucket toward the waves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are there fish? This bucket's nearly full.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fetch the aquarium from reception. I'll hold this one until you're back.

card.title: Keep Hope Operational
card.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your daughter's message came through from tomorrow. Let's put a chair beside the machine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Do you think she can come through too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We heard her voice. Bring the cushion she likes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you folded the arrival estimate under her message?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wanted her words on top. Read them to me while I clear her landing space.

card.title: Keep Hope Operational
card.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cloud machine made a drop indoors. Let's set out cups for your demonstration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You really think I can make it rain? Dad said he'd come if it worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've got the first drop. Put his cup nearest the nozzle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's the red message on your monitor?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the display. You mark the water level so we can show him any increase.

card.title: Say You Saw It Too
card.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you notice the shadow reaching the door first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd rather hear your order of events.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, it moved before the chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I can admit I held the door for it.

card.title: Say You Saw It Too
card.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did the soup wave at you too?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are you staring at the bowl?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm waiting for an independent witness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It raised a noodle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I was beginning to feel rude not waving back.
